title: feat: raise fixed issue report reward to 4 Pollen
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises the issue-to-merged-PR quest from 2 to 4 Pollen.
- Updates quest copy and focused test expectations.
- Leaves already-recorded rewards unchanged.

Tests: focused Vitest (2 passed); Biome check passed.

gist.headline: The bug garden pays better
gist.blurb: A well-spotted bug can now bloom into 4 Pollen instead of 2. Future issue-to-merged-PR quests get the larger seed packet; earlier rewards stay safely in the soil where they landed.
gist.summary: The GitHub contribution quest for turning a reported issue into a merged PR now awards 4 Pollen instead of 2, while previously recorded rewards remain unchanged.
gist.impact: Contributors whose newly reported issues lead to merged fixes can now claim 4 Pollen through the quest.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny bug-fixing gardener, wearing a tool belt and tending a code-plant where a small pixel bug has become a healthy flower. A retro quest board shows a clear 2 → 4 Pollen reward upgrade, with four glowing lime-green pollen tokens and cozy garden details to represent better rewards for useful issue reports.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener tool belt, carefully replacing a pixel bug on a code-plant with a blooming flower beside a retro quest board reading "2 → 4 POLLEN". Four glowing lime green (#ecf874) pollen tokens float above warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach garden scenery with vines and tiny terminals; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
